args.rationale: Support: Every key conclusion traces to the two live sources. Earnings figures (revenue 109.4bn +16%, GM 50.1% with ~2pp tariff refund, diluted quarterly EPS 2.02 +29% with 0.11 refund, dividend 0.27) are cited to src-aapl and match the frozen release exactly. All market figures (close 308.91, prior close 333.43, OHLC 304.81/310.69/300.00, volume 132,489,100, 10 EMA 327.24, 20 SMA/Boll middle 324.37, bands 304.22/344.51, MACD 6.82/signal 8.14/hist -1.32, RSI 45.08, ATR 9.90, VWMA 308.54) match the observed tool outputs. Derived arithmetic checks out: -24.52/-7.35%, 8.91pt/2.97% off low, 0.37pt/0.12% above VWMA, 4.69pt/1.54% above lower band, 15.46pt/4.77% below 20 SMA, 18.33pt/5.60% below 10 EMA, 64.93pt/+23.60% rally, 48.0% retracement, 3.20% ATR/price, 10.69pt true range = 1.08x ATR, 48.1% ex-refund GM, 1.91 ex-refund EPS, 5.4% and 4.0% refund shares, 1.08 annualized dividend / 0.35% yield. The report correctly refuses to fabricate 50/200 SMA, TTM EPS, trailing P/E, macro data, and prediction markets, and explicitly labels NO_DATA_AVAILABLE. Minor blemish: the News Analyst section claims the corpus has no volume or technical data, contradicting the Market Analyst section that uses them — an internal inconsistency, not a fabrication of external facts. Relevance: tightly focused on AAPL at 2026-07-31, with a clear final HOLD decision, symmetric branch triggers, and no off-topic drift; some redundancy across the four risk-seat sections but core complete. Semantic validity: the report is scrupulous about period and unit — it repeatedly labels 2.02 as quarterly (not TTM), explicitly states no TTM EPS exists and therefore no trailing P/E can be computed, and never converts a single-quarter figure into an annual/TTM metric. No unsupported numerical valuation assertion is made; all multiples are labeled UNKNOWN.
